record.paper_title: On Plane Geometric Spanners: A Survey and Open Problems
record.original_question: For finite planar point sets, improve the dependence on ε in constructions of plane Steiner (1 + ε)-spanners; in particular, can one obtain such spanners using asymptotically fewer Steiner points than the O(n/ε^4) bound described in the paper?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 17. Can the dependence on ε in the solution sketched above be improved?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a finite set of $n$ points in the Euclidean plane, and let $\varepsilon > 0$. A plane Steiner $(1+\varepsilon)$-spanner for $P$ is a planar straight-line graph $G = (V, E)$ in the plane with $P \subseteq V$ (vertices in $V \setminus P$ are called Steiner points) such that for every pair $p, q \in P$ the shortest-path distance from $p$ to $q$ in $G$ (where each edge has Euclidean length) is at most $(1+\varepsilon)\,\|p-q\|_2$. A classical construction yields such a spanner whose total number of vertices (equivalently, number of Steiner points) is $O(n/\varepsilon^{4})$.

Determine the optimal dependence on $\varepsilon$ in the size of plane Steiner $(1+\varepsilon)$-spanners. In particular, prove or disprove: for every finite planar point set of size $n$ and every $\varepsilon \in (0,1)$, there exists a plane Steiner $(1+\varepsilon)$-spanner with $o(n/\varepsilon^{4})$ vertices (and provide matching upper and lower bounds on the worst-case size as a function of $n$ and $\varepsilon$).
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work has substantially improved the O(n/ε^4) bound. A construction giving Euclidean noncrossing Steiner (1+ε)-spanners with O(n/ε^{3/2}) edges has been established for n points in the plane, together with an almost matching lower bound of Ω(n/ε^{3/2-μ}) for any μ>0. This essentially resolves the size question up to subpolynomial factors in ε, although closing the remaining gap (the μ>0 slack) and analogous questions for related spanner notions remain.

status_evidence.title: Euclidean Noncrossing Steiner Spanners of Nearly Optimal Sparsity
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs Euclidean noncrossing Steiner (1+ε)-spanners with O(n/ε^{3/2}) edges, improving the previous O(n/ε^4) bound, and provides an almost matching lower bound Ω(n/ε^{3/2-μ}).
status_evidence.claim: The O(n/ε^4) size bound for plane Steiner (1+ε)-spanners has been improved to O(n/ε^{3/2}), with an almost matching lower bound.

status_evidence.title: On Euclidean Steiner (1+ε)-Spanners (STACS 2021)
status_evidence.snippet: Steiner (1+ε)-spanners of lightness O(ε^{-1} log n) in the Euclidean plane.
status_evidence.claim: Earlier improvements addressed lightness; sparsity (number of vertices) was further improved later.
